import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { AuthService } from 'src/app/services/auth.service'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-login', templateUrl: './login.component.html', styleUrls: ['./login.component.css'], }) export class LoginComponent { loginData = { email: '', password: '', }; constructor(private authService: AuthService, private router: Router) {} onLogin() { this.authService.login(this.loginData).subscribe({ next: (res) => { console.log('Login Success', res); // ✅ Set username in localStorage (check this carefully) localStorage.setItem('username', this.loginData.email); // Navigate if (res.role === 'ADMIN') { this.router.navigate(['/admin']); } else { this.router.navigate(['/user/items']); } }, error: (err) => { alert('Invalid credentials'); }, }); } }
